Question 19
?

Write the geometric series 1+4+16+⋯+4096 using sigma notation.

Hint: You may wish to make use of the fact that 4096=46.

a
∑n=162n−1
b
∑n=172n−1
c
∑n=174n−1
d
∑n=164n−1
e
∑n=154n−1
